assessments.reasoning: The supplied instruments do not contain any question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while doing other activities or without care being their main activity. Care is only mentioned as a reason for not working (f.6), for not working more hours (f.63), or for not seeking work (f.71), which the indicator explicitly excludes from counting. Therefore, supervisory care or availability for care while doing other activities is not mentioned.
